projectDescription: An interception-based web proxy library that rewrites and sandboxes arbitrary web content inside the browser to bypass censorship and CORS restrictions.
keyFeatures: In-browser interception and rewriting of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and WebAssembly
Transparent URL encoding/decoding with configurable codecs
Service Worker-based request proxying with zero server-side rendering
Plugin system with ordered hooks (Tap) for fetch lifecycle, init, and error events
Cookie synchronization across frames and service workers
Built-in HTTP cache plugin for improved performance
Source map support for debugging proxied JavaScript
publicApiSurface: Controller (class) — orchestrates service worker, transport, and frames
Controller.createFrame(element?, options?) — creates a sandboxed iframe Frame
Controller.wait() — resolves when the controller is ready
Controller.setTransport(transport) — swap the proxy transport at runtime
Frame (class) — represents a single proxied iframe with hooks and navigation
Frame.go(url) — navigate the frame to a proxied URL
Frame.back() / Frame.forward() / Frame.reload() — history navigation
Frame.hooks.fetch / Frame.hooks.init / Frame.hooks.error — lifecycle hooks
ManagedPlugin (class) — base class for frame-aware plugins
Plugin (class) — base class for tap-aware plugins
Tap.create<T>() / Tap.tap() / Tap.dispatch() — hook system
ScramjetConfig / ScramjetFlags — configuration type interfaces
ScramjetFetchHandler — handles fetch requests through the proxy pipeline
CookieJar — manages cookies across proxied origins
ScramjetHeaders — HTTP header manipulation utility
bootstrap() (server) — downloads and serves scramjet assets, exposes routeRequest/routeUpgrade
init(cfg) (client bootstrap) — registers service worker and initializes Controller
HttpCachePlugin — RFC 9111-compliant HTTP cache for proxied responses
UrlWatcherPlugin — fires callback on frame URL changes
LinkHandlerPlugin — intercepts anchor clicks to open in new tabs via callback
CatchEscapedLinksPlugin — catches links that escape the proxy frame
EventHandlerPlugin — low-level DOM event interception for plugins
create-proxy-app CLI — scaffold a new Scramjet proxy app
